description: Companies usually work on a base of established, informal process structures. But without clear visibility into how processes actually unfold, inefficiencies remain hidden, costs pile up, and improvement efforts miss their mark. process mining changes this by transforming your event data into visual process flows, revealing exactly where bottlenecks occur, where variations drain resources, and which steps deliver the most value. Process.Science brings the power of process mining directly into Power BI, enabling you to analyze and optimize your processes without leaving your familiar BI environment. Our AI-powered visual seamlessly integrates with your existing data infrastructure, turning complex process data into actionable insights within minutes. Trial Version Check out our Process.Science Trial Version to experience process mining in Microsoft Power BI. The trial includes our core process analyzer with visual process discovery, allowing you to explore how process mining works with your data. Please note: the trial version processes up to 1,000 event log rows and includes limited features – swim lanes and up to 50,000 event log rows require the Pro plan. Enterprise Version The additionally available, far more powerful Process.Science Enterprise-Version enables your company to visualize autonomously, all processes in a chart so that all sequences are ready for analyzing.
